description: The file defines the class ImapHandler, which is a wrapper around PHP's IMAP extension functions. It implements the ImapHandlerInterface and provides methods for managing IMAP connections, fetching emails, flags, headers, and other IMAP operations, with integrated logging and error handling.

classes.name: ImapHandler
classes.description: Wrapper class for functions of IMAP PHP built-in extension, providing a higher-level interface with logging, error handling, and additional logic for email management over IMAP.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImapHandler with options for error logging, call logging, and charset.

methods.name: setStream
methods.description: Assigns a resource or boolean to the internal stream, with optional validation.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Retrieves the current IMAP stream with optional validation.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs errors if string or array and if logging is enabled.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current IMAP connection resource.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the IMAP functions are available.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens an IMAP connection with given credentials.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Pings the IMAP connection to check if it's alive.

methods.name: executeImapCmd
methods.description: Executes an IMAP command with charset handling and error retries.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a message to a mailbox.

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Retrieve UID for a message number.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks the status of the mailbox.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Retrieves message body for a section.

methods.name: utf8
methods.description: Converts MIME encoded text to UTF-8.

methods.name: isValidStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream resource is valid.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of messages with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: messageStructureHasAttachment
methods.description: Determines whether a message structure has attachments.
